name: geometry-distance
description: Select objects that fall within a certain distance of points, edges, and polygons defined in the geometry set named s. This geometric element accepts the extra keyword. If the extent keyword is used, then objects that actually intersect elements in the geometry set are considered to be at a distance of 0.0. The following keywords are available. gap f Define the maximum distance from the set for an object to be selected. If not specified, a value of 0.0 will be used.

sub_keywords.name: set
sub_keywords.description: Add an additional geometry set named s to the list of those checked.
